Torch pin verified on BOTH real build #5 artifacts. macOS: fresh extract, shipped code logged the pin and --skip-torch-or-directml, zero nightly refs, correct image at 74.95s. Windows: clean extract, engine 0.29.2, correct image at 11.30s, and the darwin branch provably did not run (no pin lines, no comfy-cli, portable torch untouched at 2.13.0+cu130). All checklist items ticked; maturity in-progress -> validating.

doing -> done (complete) on the user`s explicit approval. All 33 checklist boxes ticked. ComfyUI pinned to 0.29.2 and the stamp now READS BACK from comfyui_version.py instead of echoing the pin, which is what made the drift self-concealing. The reopened half - comfy-cli installing an unpinned PyTorch NIGHTLY on the m-series branch only, which rendered every SDXL image as uniform grey noise while every automated signal reported success - fixed in baefe4c3 by pinning stable torch 2.13.0 on darwin plus --skip-torch-or-directml, entirely inside process.platform === darwin guards. Build #5 (mpi-ci 30674488835) verified end to end on the REAL shipped artifacts: macOS correct image at 74.95s with zero nightly in the log, Windows correct image at 11.30s with the darwin branch provably skipped. Shipped in v1.3.0, published 2026-08-01.
